findings.title: Session switch displays next-turn permission mode rather than current active-run mode
findings.reproduction: Start ask Bash wait in session A, run auto task in session B, switch to waiting A: selector stays auto and disabled although A correctly waits for ask approval.
findings.resolution: Display active.permissionMode for an active run or clearly label current versus next-turn permission. No permission bypass observed.
findings.finalResolution: active ask displayed before reload and after reload

findings.title: Pre-reset context usage can overwrite post-reset usage on the same runtime
findings.reproduction: Import actual ContextUsageCache; start deferred read; disconnect while keeping same Query; complete new read(100) then old read(99000); final cache is99000.
findings.resolution: Per-session generation/epoch must guard pending refresh writes, including same-runtime conversation_reset.
findings.finalResolution: ordinary reset usage real path passed; pathological late-response race remains targeted regression proof

findings.title: MCP form empty numeric/boolean controls are converted into valid values
findings.reproduction: NativeInteraction number input onChange Number(empty string)=0; boolean empty option value is mapped to false. Required validation therefore no longer sees an absent answer.
findings.resolution: Delete answer key for empty values; convert only nonempty inputs; add focused regression. Real MCP provider form remains unverified.
findings.finalResolution: Real MCP form blank validation and typed number0/booleanfalse accepted; second actual form cancel. Native raw tool results independently corroborate model final output.

findings.title: Explicitly denied tool remains unknown in execution log
findings.reproduction: Real run669e0092-6b3b-4a75-8d94-84918c3708df has permission-result allow=false but no tool-result. activitySteps returns unknown and UI says no result received.
findings.resolution: Correlate options.toolUseID to explicit rejection/cancellation outcome; retest with the single planned ask-denial task.
findings.finalResolution: real explicit denied tool terminal, one tool call, no retry; late-event and cancel contracts covered by targeted regression

findings.title: Keyboard Escape and preview focus do not stay inside the sidebar interaction boundary
findings.reproduction: Real history/capability Escape keeps panel open; ContextMeter document listener cannot receive isolated key; attachment preview initially leaves focus on background trigger and Tab reaches background remove button.
findings.resolution: History, capabilities and ContextMeter native Escape close with trigger focus. PNG/text/PDF attachment preview starts on close, cycles both directions internally, restores background inert state and returns to original attachment button.
findings.finalResolution: Deployed real keyboard/focus retests passed for history/capabilities/context and PNG/TXT/PDF attachment modal.
